critique: The black background and soft pink glow are directionally consistent, but both frames still read as a single large, stationary centered disc rather than a field of distinct luminous blobs. The tiny sharp white core is distracting and unlike the soft vendor look. There is no meaningful spatial distribution or visible drift from t1 to t4.

suggestions.why: Switch the main emitter from the current point-like emission to a box-volume emission so the existing 500x280 emitter dimensions distribute the already-high particle count into multiple separate blobs instead of stacking them at center.
Disable the auxiliary particles that are creating the small sharp white center artifact, leaving the intended soft pink main blobs.
